interventions.detail: Use Python 3.10: code needs typing.TypeAlias (>=3.10) while numpy<1.22 pin needs <=3.10
Install with MINIMAL_KATS=1 from clone to skip unbuildable fbprophet==0.7.1/pystan==2.19.1.1; install prophet==1.1.6 instead (code imports prophet)
Override statsmodels==0.12.2 -> 0.13.5 (0.12.2 incompatible with required scipy>=1.10, no py3.10 wheel)
Pin cmdstanpy==1.2.4 (1.3 rejects prophet's bundled cmdstan: missing makefile)
Install setuptools<70 so pandas 1.3.5 can import pkg_resources
README snippets use ../kats/data/air_passengers.csv; correct path from repo root is kats/data/air_passengers.csv
